name: parrotnotes
description: Find, read, summarize and save insights for your ParrotNotes in-person meeting notes through the hosted ParrotNotes MCP server, with the parrotnotes workflow skill bundled.

interface.shortDescription: Search and summarize your in-person meeting notes
interface.longDescription: Find, search, summarize and save insights on your ParrotNotes in-person meeting notes. Ask for your latest meeting, pull out action items, or save a summary back to the note.
defaultPrompt: Summarize my most recent ParrotNotes meeting notes and list the action items.
